note: The editorial brief for the Beginner class: one entry per chapter, mirroring that tab of the Google Sheet. This is what a teacher knows about a lesson, not what a child sees — no panels, no games, no artwork, no interaction types. The app never reads this file; see CONTENT_WORKFLOW.md and CONTENT_LIBRARY.md. Once `content:pull` exists this file is written by it and hand-edits are overwritten; until then it is maintained by hand, which is why the two chapters below were filled in from the chapters that already ship.

chapters.title: The Lost Coin
chapters.curriculumNotes: Read from the four curriculum photographs in Drive (Beginners / Chapter 03 / 01 - Curriculum Source), uploaded 2026-09-15. Beginners Mar Thoma Vol-1 p.20, Sunday School Samajam. The lesson is the parable of the lost coin; the memory verse is from a different passage (St. Luke 19:10), which is the curriculum's own pairing and not an error. Artwork fetched from 04 - Story Artwork on 2026-09-16: cover plus twelve panels, all 941×1672 except panel 12, converted PNG→WebP with no resize or crop. Every panel was read before its alt text was written.

learningObjectives.objective: Recall that the woman searched until she found the one lost coin.
Understand that God looks for us in the same way, and is glad when we return.
Say the chapter's decision: I belong to God.

chapters.memoryVerse: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.
